model.description: The nano YOLOv8 pose model converted to ONNX for browser-local inference. It detects people and returns bounding boxes plus 17 COCO-style body keypoints per detection.
intendedUses: Interactive, user-reviewed human-pose overlays in browser applications.
Fitness, animation, and accessibility prototypes where approximate 2D landmarks are sufficient.
Benchmarking browser pose estimation across ONNX precisions.
limitations: Small, occluded, blurred, crowded, rotated, or partially visible people can be missed or assigned incorrect landmarks.
Two-dimensional keypoints do not establish depth, identity, intent, health, or biomechanical safety.
Accuracy can vary across body types, clothing, skin tones, camera viewpoints, lighting, and activities represented unevenly in training data.
Do not use outputs for biometric identification, surveillance, medical diagnosis, employment, law enforcement, or other consequential decisions.

fixture.preprocessing: Decode RGB, resize directly to 640×640, rescale pixels by 1/255.

expected.description: FP32/WASM normalized top-person box, confidence, and 17-keypoint signature.

benchmark.qualityGate: At least one finite person pose with a confidence of 0.5 or greater, at least five visible keypoints, valid source-image coordinates, and a normalized pose signature within 0.08 mean absolute error of the checked-in FP32/WASM reference.
benchmark.environment: Isolated headless Google Chrome on macOS; Transformers.js 4.2.0
